description: Apply once after deploying CompanyTax.js without the annual-summary output dependency. Removes the unrequested summary sheet; tax calculations and Cash Flow results remain unchanged.

values.note: Monthly movement in year-to-date taxable profit after eligible prior-year losses. Can be negative when reversing earlier profit in the same accounting year. Refresh with loan repayments.
Monthly change in year-to-date current tax after eligible prior-year losses. A negative month reverses earlier accrual in the same tax year; it is not a cash refund.
